name: Autograd Wrapper for Volume Rendering
aliases: Python autograd wrapper for volume rendering
definition: A Python `torch.autograd.Function` implementation that replaces the C++ autograd layer, routing between forward/backward C++ ops and handling gradient requirements.
summary: The Autograd Wrapper for Volume Rendering is a Python torch.autograd.Function that automates gradient routing for differentiable volume rendering, serving as a high-level entry point that invokes underlying C++ kernels rather than deriving analytical gradients itself.
